_meta.notice: All coefficients below are engineering assumptions derived from urban driving cycles (e.g. ARAI/WLTP city approximations), not empirical telemetry measurements.
_meta.formula: Fuel (L) = (idle_rate_lps * idle_s) + (stops * stop_penalty_l) + (cruise_l_per_km * distance_km); CO2 (kg) = Fuel (L) * emission_factor_kg_per_l

two_wheeler.notes: High stop-and-go sensitivity, lowest idling consumption

auto.notes: Moderate acceleration fuel spike on restart

car.notes: Air conditioning load included in baseline idle

bus.notes: Heavy inertia penalty per stop (25mL per stop)

ambulance.notes: Auxiliary medical electronics load during idle
